name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Campaign & Marketing Operations Manager
summary: Marketing operations and campaign manager with 15+ years across agency, MarTech, and B2B SaaS, owning campaigns from planning and asset development through launch, reporting, and optimization. Builds the repeatable infrastructure campaigns run on: templates, messaging frameworks, launch workflows, and 20+ automated SMS and email lifecycle sequences covering booking, reminders, onboarding, and re-engagement. Experienced coordinating partner-facing programs, including channel sales to healthcare-focused agencies at Birdeye, and writing email, landing-page, and outreach copy that drives engagement.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Architected and deployed 20+ automated SMS and email lifecycle workflows covering lead capture and routing, appointment booking with confirmations and reminders, no-show recovery, onboarding nurture, long-term reactivation, and review requests.
Build reusable marketing assets and messaging frameworks, adapting a shared template base to each client's brand and audience instead of starting from scratch.
Write and publish email sequences, landing pages, newsletters, and educational guides that explain complex systems to non-technical audiences.
Run segmented outreach campaigns end to end, including an automated audit workflow that enrolled 180+ businesses and converted 2 to paying clients.
Document every campaign timeline, deliverable, and change in HubSpot, GoHighLevel, and Notion, keeping project records auditable across concurrent engagements.
Build dashboards and regular performance reports tracking funnel progression and campaign ROI, with clear optimization recommendations.

experience.title: Campaign Strategy Lead (Account Executive / Client Strategist)
bullets: Led integrated campaigns across inbound, paid media, and content as strategic lead, coordinating execution across internal departments.
Produced campaign assets including landing pages, multi-step email sequences, and conversion-focused copy.
Designed account-based LinkedIn campaigns for small, highly researched audiences with A/B-tested setups.
Built reporting frameworks tracking ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion KPIs, delivering optimization recommendations and QBRs.

experience.title: Partner Enablement (Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding)
bullets: Onboarded and managed 15-20 reseller partners across health, home services, and retail, including channel sales to healthcare-focused agencies, retaining all but one (~94%).
Built automated product-training sequences and communication workflows that reduced onboarding friction across the partner network.
Equipped partners to communicate product value to their own customers, advising on retention strategy and automated workflows.
Shared structured, prioritized partner feedback with Product and Engineering to inform the roadmap.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Ran client campaigns end to end at a performance marketing agency, covering execution, reporting, and cross-team communication in ClickUp.
Built internal processes that improved reporting accuracy, reduced handoff errors, and strengthened cross-team alignment.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month, holding 110% of implementation targets and 120% of sales targets.
Contributed to a 30% increase in website traffic and 25% improvement in conversion rates across the e-commerce segment.
Led a team of onboarding specialists for 2 years (20, later 8), overseeing budgets, scope, and launch timelines.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science - Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO (2009)
certifications: Google Digital Marketing & E-Commerce Professional Certificate - Google / Coursera (2024)
